cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tomorrow's hike: ridge or river? I'm checking the weather against our route. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ridge. We changed because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Flood warning, then. Where are we meeting? I'll add that to the reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've asked me that twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking it works without my help. Brief me like a new recruit; I'll take notes, starting with where I report.

mechanism: A conceals lost hiking plans through leader checks, then offers B leadership credit to keep the needed itinerary information flowing.
confusable: Unlike ordinary verification, B must identify repeated forgotten questions; unlike secure command A yields status and method to retain help.
comparison: Outdoor safety and co-leadership bargaining differ from family invitation wording and a private phone readout.
seedUse: Use canonical D30-b flooded route and challenged memory with S02-b adaptive captain posture; do not inherit S01+D30-a unresolved judgment.
